messages:
Sam Chen: Heads-up — planning hackweek tutorials + lightweight OSS launch posts. Goal: 3 tutorials, 1 benchmarking blog, 1 webinar. Need owners for messaging + inbound routing. TL;DR: make content low-friction for devs to follow.

Maya Patel: Love it. Can we reuse snippets from the refapp? Aim for beginner -> integration -> ops tracks.

Jordan Lee: I'll own benchmark narrative. Quick Q: which metric focus? latency vs cost per token vs throughput?

Li Wang: For community, latency-per-dollar and a simple reproducible script wins. Suggest 3 graphs: p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k-tokens. Also include a short demo notebook.

Priya Rao: I can take tutorials (beginner + integration). Can we do 2 short videos (3-4 mins) + written guides and a ready-to-run notebook?

Sam Chen: Yes. Jordan + Li, coordinate on dataset & scripts. Maya handle launch post + social copy. Priya handle tutorial PR details.

Maya Patel: @Jordan @Li let's pick model variants: redwood-8k-quant vs open-16k. Also need a recommended config for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Jordan Lee: Agreed. I'll draft benchmark artifacts and a reproducibility checklist: env, docker, seed. Will post draft by EOD Fri.

DevRel Bot: Reminder: Hackweek sprint starts Mon 2026-03-30. Create calendar block in #marketing-events.

Li Wang: On inbound routing: propose a simple gated notebook: email capture for ‘benchmark deep-dive’ + auto-tag in HubSpot with source=hackweek-hack. @mktg-ops?

Maya Patel: We should segment leads by usage intent: POC vs platform partnership. Add hidden field in form to capture intent.

Priya Rao: For messaging iteration: let's A/B test two headlines: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency' vs 'Lower per-token cost with smart batching'. Run small social tests to dev audience.

Sam Chen: Keep A/B sample small first. Also create a short eval checklist to avoid quality regressions in benchmark claims.

Jordan Lee: Putting a small script snippet in thread:
```
# reproduce throughput
python run_bench.py --model redwood-8k --seq 1024 --batch 8
```
Make sure it's portable and has clear deps.

Maya Patel: :+1: I'll write launch post draft and add CTA to tutorial notebook + webinar signup.

Priya Rao: Can someone volunteer to host the webinar? Live demo + Q&A; 30 min.

Li Wang: I can host the ops/demo segment. Need a product engineer for the live model config — @Sam?

Sam Chen: I’ll do the product demo. Priya you host?

Priya Rao: Yep happy to moderate.

Maya Patel: Next steps: owners: Tutorials=Priya, Benchmark=Jordan, Messaging=Maya, Inbound flow=Li. Timeline: draft by Fri, review Mon, soft launch Wed.

Jordan Lee: Noted. Will ping for review once artifacts are in a temp S3 link.

DevRel Bot: Deployed: hackweek/benchmark-assets uploaded to s3://redwood-hackweek/1768504321

Sam Chen: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to align assets. Agenda: one-liners, CTAs, lead flow.

Maya Patel: Cool. Adding checklist for social images, code snippets, and short clip timestamps.

Li Wang: Also add troubleshooting notes for Dedicated customers in the tutorial ops guide (env vars, GPU limits, tf32 flags).

Priya Rao: Will add video script draft and sample slides to the PR.

Sam Chen: Great. If no blockers, let's run a dry-run demo on Tues and finalize the registration form.

Maya Patel: ACK.

Jordan Lee: ACK.

Li Wang: ACK.

Priya Rao: ACK.
